close_codes.1002: protocol violation (reason: frame_truncated, frame_type_invalid, frame_too_large on stream 0, hello_invalid, hello_timeout)
close_codes.1013: relay paused globally or over budget (reason relay_paused): long backoff
close_codes.4001: token rejected (reason: the rejection code): mint a new token, reconnect
close_codes.4003: instance not registered (reason instance_unknown): register again, then reconnect once
close_codes.4004: instance paused or frozen by the operator: stay disconnected, retry slowly
close_codes.4005: replaced by a newer connection with the same key: reconnect once, then stop, state replaced
close_codes.4010: protocol version unsupported: stop until Meshloom is updated
